prompt: Year-over-year change in covid deaths by state, 2021 vs 2022
detail: all 50 truth rows found, 8 extra rows

answer.finalSql:
WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT
    "Province_State" AS "state",
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "date") AS "year",
    SUM(COALESCE("daily_new_deaths", 0)) AS "deaths"
  FROM "86440223-249d-4b3d-9be4-159a4e615e0a"
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "date") IN (2021, 2022)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
), pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    "state",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "year" = 2021 THEN "deaths" ELSE 0 END) AS "deaths_2021",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "year" = 2022 THEN "deaths" ELSE 0 END) AS "deaths_2022"
  FROM yearly
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  "state",
  "deaths_2021",
  "deaths_2022",
  "deaths_2022" - "deaths_2021" AS "change_in_deaths",
  CASE
    WHEN "deaths_2021" = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND(100.0 * ("deaths_2022" - "deaths_2021") / "deaths_2021", 1)
  END AS "percent_change"
FROM pivoted
